description: Fork of exp144 (E=64, qk_tph=384, attn_scale_init=0.4, 392M, final 1.7101 — current E=64 SOTA). Only change: v_tph 256 -> 384. Tests whether v_lut Channel-1 is under-parameterized, analogous to the qk_tph 256->384 win in exp144. Per-layer v LUT: 12.58M -> 18.87M (+6.29M). 6 layers: +37.7M total. Estimated total params: ~430M. If this beats exp144 cleanly, v has the same headroom qk did; if not, the qk improvement was specific to the attention-scoring path.
